summary: Frontend-only UI/UX testing of the redesigned authenticated /home for 'Inglés para Hostelería'. All critical acceptance criteria from the review request pass: brand-new guest, returning guest, review section, listening/speaking shortcuts, premium gate (guest sheet), banned tool cards removed, /more lists all 5 tools, no horizontal overflow at 390px, desktop fine, 10 locales (es/en/fr sampled) render without raw i18n keys, and Practice.js session-complete uses AppShell showBottomNav={false} (no undefined Navbar).

test_results.new_guest_bartender_es: PASS - greeting='Bienvenido', subline='Bartender · Hostelería', data-state='first-step', title='Tomar un pedido de bebidas' (free bartender situation), no review section rendered, no banned tool cards, premium card visible, CTA -> /lesson/taking-a-drinks-order
test_results.returning_guest_waiter: PASS - data-state='continue', title='Recibir a los clientes', CTA -> /lesson/welcoming-guests; review status '1 elemento pendiente', 'Repasar ahora' -> /practice
test_results.listening_shortcut: PASS - navigates to /listening-practice (page loads, no crash)
test_results.speaking_shortcut: PASS - navigates to /speaking-practice (page loads, no crash)
test_results.premium_gate_guest: PASS - 'Ver Premium' opens account-gate sheet with 'Continue with Google / Apple / Not now' (guest flow)
test_results.more_lists_tools: PASS - /more shows 5 tool rows (¿Puedo trabajar en inglés?, El turno de esta noche, Entrevista de trabajo, Primera semana de trabajo, Frases de emergencia)
test_results.bottom_nav: PASS - Home tab active on mobile; content not clipped
test_results.i18n_en: PASS - greeting='Welcome back', subline='Waiter · Hospitality', no raw home.* keys visible
test_results.i18n_fr: PASS - greeting='Bon retour', subline='Serveur/serveuse en salle · Hôtellerie-restauration', no raw keys
test_results.all_10_locales_have_home_keys: PASS - 48 home.* keys present in each of de/en/es/fr/it/nl/pl/pt/ro/uk
test_results.practice_session_complete_code_review: PASS - Practice.js:335 uses <AppShell showBottomNav={false}> on session-complete screen; no Navbar reference anywhere in the file

notes: Could not drive a full practice-review session to completion through the UI headlessly (card interaction labels for grading not reliably located). Verified fix via code review per guidance that main agent has no business-logic changes.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js is clean and well-structured: good separation into PrimaryAction/ReviewSection/PracticeShortcuts/PremiumCard; proper data-testid coverage; billing.ready gate on PremiumCard matches spec.
ReviewSection shown when due!==null && !isNewUser — consistent with 'hidden for brand-new users'.

Minor: Home.js:65 defines isNewUser = attempts.length===0 && !due; relies on `!due` where `due` can be null during loading — currently harmless because section is guarded by `due !== null && !isNewUser`, but worth a comment.
test_credentials: Guests via localStorage iph_guest_id. New: a3f1d161-6a6f-468f-b414-fb36c18427bc (bartender/es); Returning: fa5e0512-6021-459d-ab51-edb53f728fcf (waiter/es, in_progress welcoming-guests + 1 due).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home redesign verified end-to-end. If retesting Practice session-complete, use returning-guest localStorage, click 'Repasar ahora' on home, then grade cards (Fácil/Bueno/Difícil) until done — screen should render 'Sesión completada' inside AppShell with bottom nav hidden.
